title: Arvia Passenger Information
updated: 2026-10-19 — V4 final-release checks and passenger guidance

sections.heading: Welcome aboard Arvia
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide. Not affiliated with P&O Cruises. Always follow current ship information and crew instructions.

sections.heading: Official ship information
sections.body:
P&O Cruises Arvia overview (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/arvia/overview
Use the official ship website to find current deck plans and verify cabin, venue and muster locations. Links and ship facilities can change.

sections.heading: Finding your way
sections.body: Save your cabin and muster information under Ship & Cabin. The schematic Deck Guide is for orientation only, not a verified cabin map. Venue decks remain unconfirmed until checked against the official deck plan.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Dining venues include Meridian, Zenith, Horizon, The Olive Grove, Sindhu, The Epicurean, The Keel & Cow and The Glass House. Check the onboard programme for current venues, prices and reservations.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Arvia offers venues such as SkyDome, Headliners Theatre, The 710 Club and Ocean Studios. Check the daily programme for schedules and availability.

sections.heading: Preparing to sail
sections.body: Confirm your documents, check-in and boarding times, insurance, luggage requirements and current travel guidance before departure.

sections.heading: Ports and sea days
sections.body: Add your personal plans and port calls in My Cruise. Always follow official all-aboard times and ship announcements.

sections.heading: Offline app and backups
sections.body: Personal records are saved on this device. Use Settings to back them up before clearing browser data. Open the app online at least once before relying on offline access.

sections.heading: Advertisements and updates
sections.body: Public information and advertisements are maintained by the app owner using JSON files in the GitHub repository. Checking for updates requires internet.

sections.heading: Dining reservations and dietary requirements
sections.body: Check the daily onboard programme or ask the restaurant team about opening hours, reservations, allergies, dietary requirements and any extra charges. Do not assume every restaurant is included in your fare.

sections.heading: Entertainment and SkyDome
sections.body: Check the onboard entertainment programme for Headliners Theatre, SkyDome and The 710 Club. Some activities or performances may require advance booking or have age restrictions. Times and availability can change.

sections.heading: Port-day essentials
sections.body: Before going ashore, check your all-aboard time, meeting place and any tender arrangements in the official daily information. Carry necessary documents, check local weather and allow time to return.

sections.heading: Accessibility and family facilities
sections.body: For accessible routes, lifts, assistance and children’s facilities, consult the official ship information and crew. Individual services and opening times can vary.

sections.heading: Using the app offline
sections.body: Open the app online before sailing to cache its files. Saved personal plans, packing and spending entries stay on this device. External P&O links and new manager updates require internet access. Make a backup before changing phones or clearing site data.

sections.heading: Before you leave home
sections.body: Check passports or accepted travel documents, booking confirmation, travel insurance, luggage labels and embarkation instructions. Download or print anything you may need without mobile data.

sections.heading: Your first afternoon onboard
sections.body: Follow the embarkation and safety instructions supplied by P&O Cruises. Find your cabin, check your assigned muster information and locate the venues you plan to visit. Opening times and activities may change.

sections.heading: Planning a port day
sections.body: Check the official all-aboard time, local time zone, whether a tender is required and your meeting point before leaving the ship. Carry the documents advised by the cruise line.

sections.heading: Food and dining planning
sections.body: Use My Cruise to record your own dining bookings and times. Confirm reservations, dietary requirements, opening hours and any extra charges with the ship; this guide does not make bookings.

sections.heading: Keeping information current
sections.body: Use Information → Check for information updates when connected. Publisher updates may replace guidance, but do not change your saved cabin details, packing list or personal planner.

sections.heading: Before you leave home
sections.body: Check your passport or travel documents, booking details, travel insurance, any required visas, luggage labels and P&O Cruises check-in instructions. Keep important documents accessible when boarding.

sections.heading: Onboard daily information
sections.body: Entertainment times, restaurant opening hours, charges, all-aboard times and excursions may change. This app does not provide live updates from the ship; check official onboard notices and crew announcements.

sections.heading: Protect your saved records
sections.body: Your planner, checklist and spending records are stored locally in this browser or installed app. Use Settings → Backup before clearing browser data or changing devices. A backup file should be kept somewhere safe.

sections.heading: Sharing this guide
sections.body: Use the Share App section to scan the QR code or share the link. Internet access is needed for someone to open the link for the first time; after installation, many personal features can be used offline.
